Slider range of Scale multiplier on Subsurface Radius (snippet-level)
tables.population: Documentation values, not a population measurement.
tables.notes: Subsurface IOR, Subsurface Anisotropy and Specular Anisotropy are Cycles-only. Scale range from a search snippet, not full page text.

tables.name: random_walk_skin_entry_model
rows: Randomly chosen entry lobe; roughness fixed
Randomly chosen entry lobe; added because pure random walk penetrates too deep into skin
tables.population: Cycles implementation detail, not a measurement.
tables.notes: Developer PR plus independent practitioner reports agree that the skin mode fixes entry roughness at 1. Mixing probability not captured.

tables.name: principled_v2_defaults_4x
rows: SSS off by default; manual says typically 0 or 1
effective red radius 50 mm, far too large for a real head
tables.population: Blender UI defaults (4.0+), recalled from training knowledge
tables.notes: Verify against the current manual; defaults may differ in 5.x.

tables.name: skin_diffuse_mean_free_path_jensen2001
tables.population: A few light-skinned subjects measured by Jensen et al. (SIGGRAPH 2001); exact n not recalled
tables.notes: Same values as Blender Internal's legacy Skin1/Skin2 SSS presets. Use as Radius with Scale = 0.001 in a metre scene. Artists often end at 40-100% of these.

tables.name: skin_ior_to_f0
tables.population: Fresnel arithmetic F0 = ((n-1)/(n+1))^2 over a contested IOR range
tables.notes: IOR range 1.35-1.55 is from training knowledge of tissue optics; the arithmetic is exact.

tables.name: cycles_skin_material_priors
tables.units: per row; Blender >= 4.0, metre scene, unit scale 1.0
tables.population: Expert starting values for adult facial skin; not a measured dataset
tables.notes: Only subsurface_anisotropy 0.8 is sourced [manual]. Radius values follow Jensen 2001 skin1. Store radius as physical mfp in mm and write Scale = 0.001 / scene.unit_settings.scale_length.

tables.name: regional_roughness_offsets
tables.units: Blender perceptual roughness, added to roughness_base
tables.population: Artist heuristics following the T-zone trend reported by Weyrich et al. 2006 (about 150 faces); offsets are not measured values
tables.notes: Author the masks once on the template's fixed topology/UVs so they transfer to every fitted head.

tables.name: skin_microgeometry_and_texel_density
rows: dermatology/profilometry; enlarged pores up to ~0.5 mm
rule of nines: 9% of 1.7-1.9 m^2 body surface
artist heuristic; >~1 mm reads as orange peel
tables.population: Adult facial skin; values vary with age, site and measurement method
tables.notes: Training-knowledge ranges; texel rows are derived arithmetic.

tables.name: mesh_resolution_for_skin
tables.notes: Rule: render edge length <= 1/4 of red mean free path. Derived arithmetic.

tables.name: scale_sanity_checks
tables.population: Adults (Dodgson 2004 for IPD; Farkas 1994 for head breadth), recalled from training
tables.notes: Use to reject non-metric fitted heads before shading (>~10% off).
